description: This file contains a PHP class 'StockStatus' that manages the CRUD operations for stock statuses in the OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, saving, and deleting stock status entries, as well as generating views and handling requests related to stock statuses.

classes.name: StockStatus
classes.description: Controller class for managing stock status entities in the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for listing stock statuses, initializes data, handles request parameters, and renders the stock status list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the display of the list of stock statuses by calling getList() and returning the rendered view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches stock status data with applied sorting, ordering, and pagination, prepares the data array for the view, and returns the rendered list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Handles the creation and editing of individual stock status entries, preparing data for the form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submissions to add or update stock statuses, performs validation, and returns JSON responses.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected stock statuses after permission validation and returns JSON response.
